name: MKI Media Hero
overview: A cinematic hero banner on the Jellyfin home screen.
description: Adds a full-width hero carousel to the Jellyfin home screen. The list is prepared on the server from recently added, top rated and (optionally) Seerr trending titles, filtered per library with title, genre, tag and rating whitelists and blacklists. Layout, transitions, text and buttons are configurable.
changelog: New settings page in the shared MKI design, with tabs for Sources, Filters, Look, Details & buttons and Behavior. A live preview draws your own list with the banner's own code at the size of your window and follows every slider while you drag; a small copy stays in the corner while you scroll. The header shows how many titles your list has, how old it is, and how many sources and library places are in use. Text placement is set by dragging the text block, layouts are picked from drawings, and Find a setting jumps to any option. The Seerr address and key can be taken over from MKI Seerr Bridge in one click. Settings save as soon as you change them, with undo, and the list is rebuilt once after each change; turning the banner off asks first. Works on phones and in light and dark themes.
